problem: Multiple heavyweight proofs for one exact revision can waste runner time by rebuilding identical source and repeatedly starting the same expensive editor/runtime process.
invariant: When several bounded proofs share one exact revision and heavyweight runtime, prepare one clean exact-SHA workspace, build once, start the runtime once, execute an allow-listed proof bundle, then validate emitted evidence without reopening the runtime. Do not reuse a live process across revisions.
evidence: docs/CI_VALIDATION_TIERS.md documents the job-local build-once/boot-once R4.1 proof suite
do_not_copy: Passo Giau map paths or R4.1 proof identifiers
failure_behavior: Any build, runtime startup, bounded proof, exact-SHA assertion or evidence validation failure fails the bundle. Arbitrary commands/paths are not accepted, and no cross-commit warm daemon is treated as proof.
